name: Appearance Of Evil
overview: Scripture calls believers to live with integrity and decency, avoiding behaviors associated with evil such as drunkenness, strife, and envy, as emphasized in Romans 13:13. Titus 2:7 encourages Christians to exemplify good works and sincerity in all things, reflecting a life free from corruption. Revelation 21:8 warns of the eternal consequences awaiting those who persist in sinful practices and deception, highlighting the seriousness of rejecting God's standards. Together, these verses instruct believers to reject the appearance of evil by embodying godly character and conduct.
